interpretation_limits: Calibration types are initial published-seed peak groups, not final independent labels.
Overlap fraction is category-union bp divided by callable peak-union bp, not fraction of nuclei or reads.
Classes/families/subfamilies can overlap; category fractions need not sum to 100%.
Genome coverage fold is descriptive chromosome weighted background, unmatched for GC, TSS/gene context or mappability.
No disease effect test, p-value or FDR; animal points are the biological units.
Genotype comparisons are age matched at 3mo; WT6mo and WT21mo remain separate aging conditions.
Peak calls and widths differ by animal, with no fragment-depth or peak-number matched inference.
No TE expression, TE fragment accessibility quantification, or final retention certification.
Zero callable or absent groups are unavailable/NA; callable no-overlap categories are true zero.
